name: adv-bench2
description: A benchmark of adversarially crafted inputs for evaluating NLP model robustness across common language tasks. It measures how well models maintain performance under intentionally perturbed or adversarial examples. Useful for assessing robustness and failure modes of text models.
reputation: A niche robustness dataset used by researchers studying adversarial NLP; not a mainstream leaderboard but referenced in robustness work.
